about_the_game:
Physics-based Chaos. Competitive Mayhem.

Roll, bounce, dash, and smash your way through the arena in Wobble Wars – a chaotic, physics-driven multiplayer game where spherical characters battle for dominance in outrageous environments. Whether you're outwitting foes in tactical objective modes or throwing your wobbly weight around in pure free-for-all madness, this is the most fun you’ve ever had as a rolling ball.

Key Features

  • Physics-Based Combat – Use momentum, ricochets, and dashes to knock opponents off the map or into traps.

  • Skill-Based Movement – Master spin boosts, bounce timing, wall bounces.

  • Play with up to 10 players online or with friends via local split-screen

  • Whether you're here to sweat in ranked matches or just laugh with friends in casual mode, Wobble Wars brings the energy, absurdity, and depth you didn't know you needed.

  • Game Modes – Capture the Flag, One Flag, Races, King of the Hill, and more.

  • New maps, seasonal content, and rotating events keep the chaos fresh.

  • Customization – Unlock hundreds of skins, trails, flags, emotes, and taunts to show off your wobble style.

short_description: Wobble Wars is a chaotic, physics-based multiplayer brawler where rolling, bouncing, and bashing are the keys to victory. Compete in hilarious arenas, master momentum-based movement, and customize your wobble warrior in the ultimate spherical showdown!
